title: Admit explicit source caption anchors with linear reprojection
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: A uniquely covered cue can be explicitly anchored to the host source window (offset from sourceRange.start under a linear time map). timelineRange stays the projection of that window.
New and imported uniquely covered cues still default to clipLocal, never source. Made-absolute cues stay at authored times until re-anchored.

Source cues reproject on already-opened MoveClips, overwrite, paste, insert-move, and ripple delete/close/trim when a unique same-stream host still fully covers that source window, including a split remnant. Cue versions are bumped when the projection changes.

An interval or rewrite that would uncover or crop a source cue refuses the whole command (ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE) and leaves the document unchanged. This slice does not silently crop, split, or drop source-anchored text.

Non-linear or non-positive rates refuse TIME_MAP_MISMATCH. Styles, words, speakers, and MP4 / preview text burn-in stay refused (CAPTION_RICH_EDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED / CAPTION_RENDER_POLICY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED). Sidecar export is used.

Already-delivered leave-gap, single-range ripple delete/close, shorten and lengthen ripple trim, reject/overwrite/insert, includeLinks=false, insert-move leave-gap, caption default clipLocal / follow / interval crop, and marker absolute default / clipLocal follow / ripple interval stay unchanged. Lifting a clipLocal marker host is still an atomic REF_NOT_FOUND.
Not auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, I-006 roll/slip/slide, source-interval crop, field-aware inverse, 1000 random NLE undo, or marker sidecar formats.
I-005 and I-010 remain partial; 87 counts stay 26/48/13/0; XD10 unchanged.
